core_rules: Ledger is source/planning memory, not canonical Plans.
Live non-pipeline Plans docs and schema drafts are canonical after compile.
PlanCompile runtime remains design-only/disabled until later explicit enablement.
Do not run PlanCompile or build WorkNodes/NodeSeeds from this ledger.
Node readiness is runtime_disabled until runtime PlanCompile/node-artifact enablement exists.
Governance/shard registration is metadata-only and must not create runtime or build artifacts.
